# gravitino_health Data Source



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gravitino_health" "status" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `checks` (Block List) Health check details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--checks))
- `status` (String) The aggregate health status.

<a id="nestedblock--checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `checks`

Read-Only:

- `details` (Map of String) Additional details for the health check.
